title: Real-data budgeting with item A class handling
notes: Reference values are the normal-connectivity column of the revised manuscript's Table XIII. The current variant must reproduce them before the handled variant is interpreted.

inherits_from.note: Rerun_Spec item C applies the best class-handling setting from item A to every per-modality edge and cloud model. Item A selected resampling. The representation is deliberately not carried over: item C moves one factor so that the handled and current columns differ only in class handling. Item A reported that the text pathway is not informative under its primary rule in 0 of 7 rotations, so the handling is applied because the spec requires the factor to be tested in the pipeline rather than because item A found a signal.

why_frozen: Frozen before the run. Its sha256 is recorded beside it and in the run manifest, so the text cannot be edited afterwards without breaking the digest that makes the run auditable.
